name: Homestead-Miami Speedway (2.3-mile road course)

career.layout: Road course using oval turns 3 and 4
career.lengthSource: Official SCCA 2019 Palm Tree Winter Majors results (Orbits, printed 7 January 2019): "Homestead-Miami Speedway 2.30 2.300 miles" on every group | https://www.scca.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/2019_0105_M_Homestead_Results.pdf
career.layoutCall: 2.300-mile road course using oval turns 3 and 4 (not the 2.21-mile all-infield course): SCCA U.S. Majors Tour Southeast Conference, Formula F, 4-6 January 2019, two races recorded as gaps. The official results PDF prints 2.300 miles for every group that weekend, Bryce's Group 7 included.

meta.heightsNote: OSM height or building:levels x 3.4 m + 1 m where tagged (real: true); otherwise defaults, not data: 6 m buildings, 8 m grandstands, 4 m bleachers; Overture footprints 6 m
meta.treesNote: trees from OSM woods (one per 9 m), tree rows and single trees, and ESA WorldCover tree cover (one per 10 m cell) where OSM has no wood; positions jittered up to 3-4 m by a fixed hash; none drawn by hand

circuit.startFinishNote: start/finish at an approximate point: beside the middle of the pit lane (OSM way 1328685646, its 528 m along the loop); OSM has no start/finish node here and no official map was checked

model.pitNote: OSM way 1328685646 ("pit lane"), 528 m, nearest the start/finish (27 m)
